item.title: [GOOD] BSEC Initiates Reforms to Shorten Settlement Cycle and Eliminate Wet Signatures
item.description:
Category: Good

The Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) is taking steps to reduce the stock settlement cycle and remove the requirement for physical wet signatures. These reforms are expected to streamline trading processes, improve market efficiency, and enhance investor convenience by modernizing the capital market infrastructure.

Why this matters: These regulatory changes will enhance market efficiency and investor convenience.
